note: Research 2026-08-11. GitHub topic search (html5-game/webgl-game/webgpu/emscripten-game) returns ~1885 public repos but is dominated by ENGINES and templates, not playable games. Of 52 permissively-licensed hits, only the six below are droppable into an iframe. Topic mining is therefore low-precision and not a bulk source. js13kgames.com year pages are JS-rendered so entries are not in static HTML; mining it needs the GitHub org route (js13k requires open-source entries) or their API if one exists. itch.io HTML5+free is high-precision (every entry is a game) but mostly all-rights-reserved even when free, so bulk use recreates the current licence exposure; its sanctioned route is itch own iframe embed.
